notes.title: Introducing Solo Matches & Major Multiplayer Changes
notes.notes:
Introducing Solo Matches

 The game will now allow you to have a solo match while you wait for other players to join!
 Solo matches will only have 1 round per session.
 You will even earn Rumbles if you win a solo match.
 Solo match will include games modes which are playable as single player.
 Solo matches will choose the game mode which you have selected. And if you have not selected any game which is supported by a single player then the solo match will override your choice and will include games on its own.
 Solo match will not start if someone joins a lobby while countdown.


You can now join Started Lobbies!

 Now you will be able to join mid / started games!
 If the game is started, you will join as spectator until the session ends.


Multiplayer Improvements

 Improved Bomb Tag game mode! (Internal changes)
 Reduced huge loads on the Host, while maintaining, processing and updating all joined player data. This will improve game stability as the host will now not have much load especially with a high amount of players.
 The game will no longer Wait for players who are already eliminated and are just spectators when a new game is about to start. This will reduce the chances of the game getting stuck at Waiting For Players.


Changes & Fixes

 Increased radius of Bomb Sounds (Burning, Explosion).
 Reduced Football game duration to 2 Minutes when only 2 players are playing it.
 Fixed a bug in Mingle which sometimes doesn't kill players which are not inside rooms.

notes.title: Version 1.3.7 is Here!
notes.notes:
Quality of life update!
What's new:

 New Improved Main Menu! Changed the Environment and UI.
 Imrproved user exprience when opening Get Rumbles UI, you will no longer blocked by a Loading Screen saying Loading Products.
 Stick Tag will now play intense tick sound when time left is less than 10 seconds.
 The purchasing server is back online!
 Various fixes and improvements!

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 is here! Added new Lobby Map & More!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.1 is here!

What's new:

 Added new Lobby Map: Large Pool!

 Added Symbol which will appear when Host has modifed Game Mode or Map.

 Team games will no longer be selected if the required number of teams would result in an uneven player distribution, as this could create an unfair gameplay experience.

 If a team game has been specifically selected from the game selection, the system will attempt to prioritize other game modes when available.

 However, if the last played game mode is one of the alternatives and the only remaining option is a team game, the system will override its rule to prevent repeating the last played mode. In such cases, the team game will not be selected due to the uneven player distribution, and players will need to replay the previous game mode instead.

notes.title: Version 1.3 is Here! 2 New Game Modes and Maps and More!
notes.notes:
New in Version 1.3
Features:

 Added 2 NEW Game Modes: Football and a popular game Red Light Green Light!
 Added 2 NEW Maps: Skyfield Stadium and Rush Yard!
 Added a feature which will let the lobby host to Disable Game modes and Maps in the lobby! It can be changed anytime.
 Added Ban / Unban feature. You can now ban players from the lobby! After banning the player you can also unban the players easily from the UI.
 Added support for Discord Rich Presence!
 Added support for Guest Sign In, you can use it if you are unable to sign in with Steam account. You can always convert the guest account to Steam account from Main Menu.


Fixes:

 Increase the height of the lobby name text, so that the entire text will not get hidden when the character size is greater than the text height.
 Fixed the version color bug in Lobby list UIs, which shows the red color of version text sometimes even if the user and host are on same version.


Changes:

 Bomb Tag and Stick Tag will no longer continue to run when the player alive is 1 and the player who left didn't had bomb and stick before leaving.
 Slightly increased the walk, sprint speed of player while playing Football. This also applies in crouch walk and sprint.


Improvements:

 Optimized Chat system!
 Other Various Improvements!

notes.title: Qualty Update
notes.notes:
What's new:


 Changed crosshair.
 Fixed various issues related to Cursor and movement, which gets enabled sometimes while chatting, navigating lobby player list UI, etc.
 The camera rotation will now stop when player is typing in chat.
 The Lobby Details UI now closes with Tab key.
 Fixed a bug where confirm kick UI didn't got hidden when a new scene gets suddenly loaded.
 Added Discord hooks which will notify Discord server players about new public lobbies which gets created along with lobby join code.
 Other various improvements.
